findings.title: Exhausted federated recovery credentials are not removed
findings.body: When the last recovery code is used, this calls `removeStoredCredentialById`, which removes only a credential from Keycloak's local store. For a credential returned by `getFederatedCredentialsStream()`, this does not remove the credential from user storage. The following required action may create a replacement, but until then the old federated credential remains configured and its consumed codes can still be accepted if the storage provider does not independently invalidate them. Remove the federated credential through the user-storage credential API, or otherwise ensure it can no longer be used.
